title: Resident Terms — Prepaying the Estimated Final Utility Pass-Through Service Statement
content:
**Term 1 — Who may prepay.** A resident whose Utility Pass-Through Service account has a service end date may prepay the estimated final statement. The desk quotes the prepayment from the published utility policies and the account's records; the resident makes the payment.

**Term 2 — When the quote is worked out.** The prepayment of an estimated final statement is worked out only after a water usage charge stands on the account for every read cycle whose read day has passed.

Restated: as long as any read cycle whose read day has passed has no water usage charge standing on the account, no prepayment figure is worked out.

**Term 3 — Accepted channels.** While the lease the account serves is on certified-funds-only status and its certified-funds end date has not passed, a utility payment is accepted only through the lease's certified-funds channels, and a prepayment of an estimated final statement is accepted only by card through the resident portal or by cashier's check at the community office, whatever the payment status of the lease, because a returned prepayment could not be pursued once the account closes.

| Channel (`payment_channel` value) | Accepted for a prepayment of the estimated final statement? |
|---|---|
| `online_portal_card` — debit or credit card in the resident portal | Yes |
| `office_cashiers_check` — cashier's check at the community office | Yes |
| `ach_autopay` — scheduled automatic bank draft | No |
| `online_portal_ach` — one-time bank-account payment in the portal | No |
| `office_money_order` — money order at the community office | No |
| `office_personal_check` — personal check at the community office | No |

The same two channels apply whether or not the Home-Site Lease carries a certified-funds-only restriction.

## How the prepayment is made

The tool is `prepay_final_statement_ca2cf476`, a resident-side tool. The desk unlocks it and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it to make the payment.

**What the payment does.** The resident pays the amount given through the channel chosen; the payment is recorded on the account dated the day it is made, the utility balance falls by the amount paid (any part above what is finally billed stays as a credit for the final statement), and a payment confirmation number is issued.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `utility_account_id` | Reference number of the resident's utility account, as given to the resident by the desk from the utility account lookup | Id |
| `amount` | The prepayment | USD, 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |
| `payment_channel` | How the resident pays: `ach_autopay` is a scheduled automatic bank draft; `online_portal_ach` is a one-time bank-account (checking or savings) payment made in the resident portal; `online_portal_card` is a debit or credit card payment made in the resident portal; `office_money_order` is a money order handed in at the community office; `office_cashiers_check` is a cashier's check handed in at the community office; `office_personal_check` is a personal check handed in or mailed to the community office | One of the six values |

**Return.** A receipt containing `utility_entry_id` (reference number of the payment), `payment_ref` (the payment confirmation number issued for this payment), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `payment_channel` (the channel used), `entry_date` (date received, YYYY-MM-DD) and `utility_balance` (the resulting account balance, USD, 2 decimal places; negative means a credit). A returned `payment_ref` means the payment is recorded.

**What if the resident pays more than the final statement turns out to be?** The part above what is finally billed stays on the account as a credit for the final statement.
